name: AAC - 15 - Publish Approved Article to WordPress

nodes.name: Set Featured Image and Prepare Post

parameters.content:
## AAC Phase 1J - WordPress Publisher

Loads only fully approved articles whose practice explicitly specifies `publisher_type = WORDPRESS`, a real public website and an explicit `publisher_config_reference` containing `wordpress_base_url`. It resolves publishing tokens, imports the campaign hero image into the target WordPress media library, sets it as the post featured image and in the article body, adds the doctor headshot to the author bio when present, reuses an existing post with the same slug, and records the publication in BigQuery. A campaign topic may provide a past or current WordPress display date; the audit timestamp remains the actual publication time.

Before running:
1. Connect **Google BigQuery account** to both BigQuery nodes.
2. Create/select the WordPress API credential named by the practice's `publisher_config_reference` on the post lookup, media upload, and post publish HTTP nodes.
3. Confirm `wordpress_base_url` is the intended WordPress multisite subsite, and that the credential belongs to that subsite. Never derive the WordPress API URL from the public static website.

Only practices marked active with a complete WordPress configuration are eligible. Non-test practices must also carry `mapping_status: VERIFIED`. The Headless Hostman static-site release remains a separate step.

Pilot exception: only campaign `campaign_test_202609_aac_prestonwood_pilot_2026_09_23` and doctor email `jdold@apexdp.com` may route from the TEST001 test practice to `https://apexparent.hostmanpowered.com/dfw-03`. The TEST001 configuration must still match exactly before the exception applies. All other campaigns publish only to the verified WordPress base stored on their linked practice. This is a WordPress publication, not a Headless Hostman static release.

parameters.sqlQuery:
-- Select one exact approved article whose practice has an explicitly verified WordPress mapping.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.publication_records` (
  publication_id STRING NOT NULL, article_id STRING NOT NULL, version_number INT64 NOT NULL,
  publisher_type STRING NOT NULL, publisher_config_reference STRING, external_post_id STRING,
  status STRING NOT NULL, requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, published_at TIMESTAMP,
  published_url STRING, last_error STRING
);
SELECT a.article_id, a.interview_id, a.doctor_id, a.practice_id, a.campaign_id,  a.status AS article_status, a.current_version, d.doctor_name, d.credentials, LOWER(d.email) AS doctor_email,
  prior_publication.external_post_id AS prior_wordpress_post_id,
  prior_publication.published_url AS prior_wordpress_url,
  d.photo_source_url, t.featured_image_source_url, t.featured_image_alt_text,
  JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(t), '$.wordpress_publish_date') AS wordpress_publish_date,
  JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(t), '$.wordpress_slug') AS topic_wordpress_slug,
  p.practice_name, p.website_domain, p.publisher_type, p.publisher_config_reference,
  v.content AS publication_package_json
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` v
  ON v.article_id = a.article_id AND v.version_number = a.current_version
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p ON p.practice_id = a.practice_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT article_id, external_post_id, published_url
  FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.publication_records`
  WHERE publisher_type = 'WORDPRESS' AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(external_post_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY version_number DESC, published_at DESC, requested_at DESC) = 1
) prior_publication ON prior_publication.article_id = a.article_id
LEFT JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interviews` i
  ON i.interview_id = a.interview_id AND i.campaign_id = a.campaign_id AND i.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
LEFT JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_topics` t
  ON t.topic_id = i.topic_id AND t.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.publication_records` pr
  ON pr.article_id = a.article_id AND pr.version_number = a.current_version
  AND pr.publisher_type = 'WORDPRESS' AND pr.status = 'PUBLISHED'
WHERE a.article_id = @article_id
  AND (
    (NOT COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(@allow_republish AS BOOL), FALSE)
      AND a.status = 'MARKETING_APPROVED'
      AND a.published_at IS NULL AND pr.article_id IS NULL)
    OR (COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(@allow_republish AS BOOL), FALSE)
      AND pr.article_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(pr.external_post_id), '') IS NOT NULL)
  )
  AND p.active = TRUE
  AND UPPER(COALESCE(p.publisher_type, '')) = 'WORDPRESS'
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.wordpress_base_url')), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.credential_name')), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.website_domain), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    p.practice_id = 'practice_test_001'
    OR UPPER(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.mapping_status'), '')) = 'VERIFIED'
  )
LIMIT 1;

-- AAC Phase 1J
MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.publication_records` T
USING (
  SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS publication_id, @article_id AS article_id,
    CAST(@current_version AS INT64) AS version_number, 'WORDPRESS' AS publisher_type,
    @publisher_config_reference AS publisher_config_reference,
    @external_post_id AS external_post_id, 'PUBLISHED' AS status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS requested_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS published_at,
    @published_url AS published_url
) S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id
  AND T.version_number = S.version_number
  AND T.publisher_type = S.publisher_type
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  publisher_config_reference = S.publisher_config_reference, external_post_id = S.external_post_id,
  status = S.status, published_at = S.published_at, published_url = S.published_url, last_error = NULL
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (publication_id, article_id, version_number, publisher_type, publisher_config_reference,
   external_post_id, status, requested_at, published_at, published_url, last_error)
VALUES
  (S.publication_id, S.article_id, S.version_number, S.publisher_type, S.publisher_config_reference,
   S.external_post_id, S.status, S.requested_at, S.published_at, S.published_url, NULL);

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles`
SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), published_url = @published_url
WHERE article_id = @article_id;

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors`
SET status = 'PUBLISHED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE campaign_id = @campaign_id AND doctor_id = @doctor_id;

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', @article_id, 'article.published', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  'n8n:wordpress-publisher', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(CAST(@current_version AS INT64) AS version_number, @external_post_id AS external_post_id, @published_url AS published_url))
FROM (SELECT 1) seed
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
  WHERE entity_type = 'article' AND entity_id = @article_id AND event_type = 'article.published'
    AND JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.external_post_id') = @external_post_id
);

SELECT @article_id AS article_id, 'PUBLISHED' AS status, @external_post_id AS external_post_id, @published_url AS published_url;
